inlines.v: 'ARTLESS, adjective 1. Unskillful; wanting art, knowledge or skill. 2. Free from guile, art, craft or stratagem; simple; sincere; unaffected; undesigning; as an artless mind. 3. Contrived without skill or art; as an artless tale.
